operating_systems.reason: Relies extensively on modern Swift Concurrency, AppKit, AVFoundation, and macOS-specific private MultitouchSupport frameworks.

distribution_and_signing.gatekeeper_behavior: Downloads are quarantined by macOS (com.apple.quarantine) and trigger 'damaged or cannot verify developer' alerts unless overridden via xattr -cr or System Settings 'Open Anyway'.
distribution_and_signing.sandboxing: Not sandboxed; uses direct Unix domain sockets for Discord RPC and private MultitouchSupport dynamic library linking.

trackpad_gestures.reason: EdgeVolumeEngine specifically parses raw multi-touch digitizer frame coordinates from MultitouchSupport; standard mouse pointers do not generate touch digitizer events.

display_notch_clipping.notch_overlap_risk: On 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros with dense menu bars (>15 status icons), macOS system menu manager may conceal the Mooziac menu bar icon behind the camera notch.
display_notch_clipping.workaround: Use menu bar organizers like Ice, Bartender, or hidden-bar.

unsupported_formats: DSD / DSF / DFF direct stream digital audio

graphic_equalizer.notes: No 10-band or parametric EQ currently exists in the app. Audio is output flat and bit-perfect, governed only by -14 LUFS loudness normalization.

variable_playback_speed.notes: Playback speed is locked to standard 1.0x; no pitch shifting or podcast speed acceleration (1.25x/1.5x/2.0x).

spatial_audio_rendering.notes: Standard stereo/surround CoreAudio passthrough only; no custom binaural virtualizer or Dolby Atmos decoder.

streaming_service_limitations.notes: Mooziac is architected specifically around the YouTube Music WebKit bridge and local disk audio; it is not a multi-service aggregator.

tag_editing.notes: Mooziac reads metadata (ID3, Vorbis, MP4) via AVMetadataItem for display and search indexing, but does not allow editing or writing tags back to disk.

playlist_portability.notes: Playlists are stored in the local SQLite database at ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/mooziac.sqlite. Exporting to standard .m3u8 files is currently an open feature request.

multi_library_switching.notes: A single active local library database is maintained per user account.

custom_hotkey_rebinding_gui.notes: Global shortcuts (Cmd+Opt+Space, Cmd+Shift+L, etc.) are currently hardcoded; a visual hotkey recorder GUI in Settings is an open feature request.

custom_accent_color_picker.notes: OLED Dark Mode uses fixed high-contrast neon white accents; hex/RGB color picker is planned.

window_snapping.notes: Main window uses standard macOS AppKit resizing; no integrated tiling manager.

discord_rich_presence.notes: Communicates exclusively via native local Unix domain sockets (/tmp/discord-ipc-0). Does not support Discord in a browser tab.

scrobbling.workaround: Works with external third-party scrobblers (Neptunes, Scroball) that listen to macOS MPNowPlayingInfoCenter.
